title: Places: values over a map: what its pitfalls cost on its replica
question: On the Places: values over a map replica, how much better does a wrong split or a kept leak make the score look?
setup_summary: 3 seeds of the places replica; 20% held out; histogram gradient boosting with default settings; mean absolute error; right split: whole blocks of 5 km.

claims.statement: On the Places: values over a map replica, a random split instead of whole blocks of 5 km makes the mean absolute error look better by 19486.9478 on average over 3 seeds (95% interval 3015.8428 to 35958.0529).
limitations: Invented replica data with its traps planted, one model family with default settings: the size of the effect on a real table differs; the direction is what the replica shows.
